tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag 'jug bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos grub rin chen mi zad gter// rdo rje rnal 'byor mar btud nas// de yi byin rlabs rgya mtsho yis// 'byor par bya phyir 'dir bshad bya// chos kyi tshul 'di la zhugs shing 'di nyid kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i gang zag byin rlabs dang dngos grub don du gnyer bas/ dus bzang po la gnas dben zhing yid du 'ong bar/ dri bzang po dang ba byung gis byugs pa'i gzhi tshon dmar pos yongs su bsgyur ba la/ re kha dkar pos phyi'i mu khyud dang bcas pa'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris pa'i steng du/ ka pā la bdud rtsi dang sbyar ba'i chang gis yongs su bkang ba bzhag nas/ de'i steng du sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor dpe'u ris bzhin gser gyi thur mas bris pa'i dbus su/ dri ma med pa'i ting lo chung du bzhag pa'i steng du dar dmar po la sogs pa'i dar khang mdzes par phub pa'i khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ shin tu zhim pa'i bza' ba dang*/ btung ba dang*/ 'bras bu la sogs pas yongs su bskor zhing gtor ma gsum dang*/ nang mchod la sogs pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs bzhin bshams shing*/ gzungs thag gis dkris pa'i rdo rje dang dung chos dang bcas pa'i bum pa bcud rnams kyis bkang ba gcig kyang bshams la/ zhu ba 'bul ba nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'i bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo ltar bya'o// de nas suṃ bha'i sngags brjod cing nang mchod kyis sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la gtor te bsangs nas/ swa bhā was stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung ram̐ las me lam̐ las sa sum̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du/

kam̐ las thod pa dkar po shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i steng du/ pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ e'i yi ge gnyis brtsegs pa las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas nyis brtsegs khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngags kyi yi ge dmigs pa rnams las 'od zer phar 'phros/ tshur 'dus gcig tu 'dres pa las byung ba'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bskyed nas/ go cha dgod pa dang ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar/ tshogs 'khor gyi skabs bzhin bya'o// de nas bum pa suṃ bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i bum pa bskyed pa'i nang du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bskyed nas ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas pa la phyi nang gyi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa byas nas gzungs thag bzung ste/ sngags gzungs thag la brten nas bum pa'i nang du song bas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs bskul nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun zags pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ rje btsun ma'i sngags gang grub pa dang*/ suṃ bha'i sngags gang grub pa dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs pa bzlas nas/ slar yang mchod cing bstod de/ dung chos kyi chu blugs pas lha'i sku yang 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam mo// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du bsdad nas/

bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba bdag la rtse gcig tu dgongs pa mngon sum ltar dmigs la maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mdzad par bsam zhing*/ gdong g.yogs bcing*/ me tog phreng ba blang*/ bum pa'i chus bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing nang mchod myangs pas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang zhing byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de nas rang gi snying gi nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor bsams nas/ rje btsun mas snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ gsang bar gdams par mdzad par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho/ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes gsungs shing byin gyis brlabs nas/ deng khyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes brjod do// de nas rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdag dkyil 'khor du bcug par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod do// de nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rjes su zlo bar bsam zhing*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces lan gsum brjod do// de nas khyad par du sdig pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa bshags par bya/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe thog ma mchis pa nas/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang*/ khyad par du bla ma dang*/ yi dam gyi lha la ma gus pa dang*/ mchod pa dang gtor ma la ma brtson pa dang*/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa la g.yel ba la sogs pa sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang nyes pa dang*/ ltung ba'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags so// mi 'chab bo// mi sbed do// slan cad kyang gcod cing bsdam lags so// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams blang ba'i bsam pas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum brjod pas rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig dang sdom pa blang ngo*// de nas khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams blang ba'i bsam pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// he ru ka dpal sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par gzung*// zhes lan gsum brjod pas blong ngo*// de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang zhing khyab pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas 'od 'dus pa lte ba'i nang du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du bam̐ gyi yi ge sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba cig tu gyur nas/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od 'jig rten thams cad la phog pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'ba' zhig tu gyur nas 'od tshur 'dus te rang la thim pas/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur nas/ go cha bcing ba'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ de nas bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la/ slob dpon khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi dngos grub dang*/

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas dkyil 'khor gyi ting lo sbar la/ de rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa de nyid kyi thugs kar/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mthe bong gi tshad dang mnyam par gyur pa/ rje btsun ma nyid kyis bdag gi khar bcug par bsam zhing*/ mid pas mgrin pa dang snying ga nas dmar hril gyis song ba/ lte ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ dang 'dres pa las byung ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsal bar bskyed la/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bde ba chen pos yongs su gang bas gar mdzad/ nang gi chos 'byung gi grwa bzhi dang*/ phyi'i lha mo'i smin mtshams kyi thad ka rnams su dga' ba 'khyil ba dmar po g.yon phyogs su myur du 'khor bar bsam mo// de'i tshe mdun gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sngags kyi sgra drag tu bsgrags pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskul nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par gyur pa bdag la thim pas/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam zhing*/ sgrub pa'i grogs rnams kyis gu gul gyi dud pa dang*/ rol mo'i sgra byed du gzhug go /de nas rje btsun mas bdag gi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje bzhag nas/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par byas par bsam/ ye shes bab pa las byung ba'i nyams myong ma brjed par bskyang*/ de nas me tog phreng ba rje btsun ma'i thugs kar phul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes brjod nas maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dbul/ phreng ba de sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rje btsun mas bdag gi spyi bor bzhag par bsams la/

oṃ pra ti grih+na s+t+wa mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la oṃ/ zhes gsung bar bsam zhing spyi bor blang*/ de nas oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ pa hrīḥphaiṃ/ zhes gsung zhing gdong g.yogs phye nas dkyil 'khor bstan par bsams shing dngos su blta'o// 'jug pa'o// de nas dbang blang ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul la/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar mkha' spyod ma dpal gtso// de ni bdag la'ang deng mdzod cig /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur dmigs pa'i mdun du rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur dmigs pa'i steng du gdugs dang*/ sa dang nam mkha' thams cad mchod pas gang bas bdag la mchod par bsam/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha 'phros pas so sos dbang bskur ba'i las mdzad/ khyad par lha mo nyid rigs lnga dang bcas pas rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi chus gang bas spyi bo nas blugs shing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ tsakra bī ra s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes mgrin gcig tu gsung zhing dbang bskur bar bsam/ dngos su yang gtor bas spyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ spyi gtsug tu rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ de nas rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rab tu gnas par bya'o// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes gsung bar bsam zhing me tog gtor nas/ rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur bar bsam mo// de nas thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bgrang phreng bzung nas/

bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas bdag gi snying ga'i bam̐ gyi mtha' mar g.yon skor du bkod pas/ rje btsun ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs bdag la zhugs par bsam zhing*/ gsang sngags lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs te spyi bor bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum gsungs nas/ sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba byin par bsam mo// de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon blangs la/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du byugs pas sku'i dngos grub thams cad 'grub par bsgom zhing*/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob snyam du bsam mo// bum pa'i dbang ngo*// //de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar maṇ+ḍal gyi thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa/ rje btsun ma nyid kyis bdag gi kha'i sgor byin par bsam zhing*/ dngos su 'thungs pas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod do// ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsam/ gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// //de nas yang g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sin+dhu ra'i rdul tshon blangs te/ rang gi gsang gnas dang*/ lte ba dang*/ snying ga dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ skra mtshams rnams su reg pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le bdag gi bha ga nas zhugs nas/ lus thams cad la khyab pas rim pa bzhin ye shes kyi dga' ba bzhi skyes par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/

zhes brjod do// yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam mo// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// //de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid ltos// nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// zhes chos thams cad stong pa nyid du ngo sprad nas/ rang nyid kyang stong pa nyid kyi ngang la sems mnyam par gzhag go /de nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi pa thob snyam du bsams nas/ dbang thams cad gnang ba'i bka' drin gyi lan du/ lus longs spyod thams cad yid kyis phul nas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ tshogs la longs spyad pa dang*/ gshegs su gsol nas bdag nyid bsrung ba'i bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzhin bya'o// bye brag tu sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ sin+dhu ra rnams ni za ma tog la sogs par legs par bzung la/ phyis kyi'ang rdul tshon la bsre bar bya'o// tshul de ltar rtag tu byas na/ sdig pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing*/ tshe dang*/ dpal dang*/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thob ste/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs nas myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// mkha' spyod dpal gyi dkyil 'khor du// bdag nyid zhugs nas dbang blang ba'i// tshul 'di zab mo'i snying po ste// gsang ba las kyang gsang ba yin// de lta mod kyis tshul 'di la// dad cing shes rab rab gsal ba// go go chen gyis gsol btab nas// sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar// dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// mkha' la spyod pa'i dpal thob nas// gnyis su med par rol par shog

/dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing*/ dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa blang ba'i cho ga 'di ni/ lcags pho rta'i lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin par shang to'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
